title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: At AI Tutor, protecting your privacy and academic learning data is central to our commitment to safe, personalized education.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
content: We collect user account information (such as email, name, and grade level) necessary to create your learning profile and personalize your tutoring experience.
We process your study queries, prompt inputs, code submissions, quiz responses, and progress milestones to tailor adaptive tutoring explanations to your level.
We gather non-personal diagnostic and telemetry data (such as response times and interface interactions) to continually improve platform reliability.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
content: Your inputs are used strictly to provide real-time tutoring feedback, generate study summaries, and recommend practice exercises.
Your private academic prompts and personal data are never sold or rented to third-party advertisers.
Aggregated, anonymized learning benchmarks may be analyzed to improve pedagogical models.

sections.title: 3. Data Security & Cloud Storage
content: AI Tutor utilizes enterprise-grade encryption both in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest via our Supabase cloud database.
Row Level Security (RLS) policies strictly enforce that your chat history, quiz attempts, and profile data can only ever be accessed by your authenticated session.

sections.title: 4. Cookies & Session Storage
content: Our platform uses secure browser storage and session cookies to maintain your login credentials and active study state.
You can manage cookie settings in your browser, though disabling session storage will prevent account login.

sections.title: 5. Your Rights & Contact Details
content: You have the full right to export, modify, or permanently delete your account and conversation history at any time.
For privacy concerns or data requests, contact our team at privacy@aitutor.app.
